# Tee365

> Tee365 is a 24/7 self-serve indoor golf simulator facility at 4615 Grape Rd, Unit A, Mishawaka, IN 46545, minutes from Notre Dame and serving South Bend and the Michiana region. Private bays run on Uneekor EYE XR launch monitors. Book online, get a door code by text, and play any hour of any day. No staff, no bar, golf first.

Key facts:

- Open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, including holidays.
- Bays are booked by the hour, priced per bay (up to 4 players). Rates vary by season, day of the week, and time of day, like an outdoor course. Live prices for every time slot are at https://tee365.org/book
- Bring your own clubs or use free loaner clubs from Clubbie Corner.
- No food or drink is sold on site; bring your own. No alcohol allowed.
- Minors are welcome with a parent or guardian.
- Phone: +1 574-444-9365. Email: info@tee365.org
